caption:
3 ways to make your Claude videos look nothing like everyone else’s 👇comment LINK and i’ll send you all my favourite GitHub projects 🔗

open-source projects: stop building every effect from scratch. i paste a GitHub link into Claude and it pulls in the real code (thinking orbs, 3D line art, a free mascot library)

context: i work in a workspace, not one-off chats. Claude already knows my past projects, my brand and my templates, so “put my best clips in a profile grid” just works

music: i generate a Suno track that actually fits the pace and mood of the edit

#aiforbeginners #editor #contentcreator
author: softgirlnocode
title: 3 Tips to Make Claude Video Edits Unique
one_liner: Use Claude with open-source GitHub effects, persistent workspace context, and AI-generated music to create standout video edits.
key_points: Paste GitHub links into Claude to pull real open-source animation code (thinking orbs, 3D line art, mascot libraries) instead of building from scratch
Work in a Claude workspace so it retains your brand, past projects, and templates — enabling natural-language edit commands
Generate custom Suno music tracks matched to the pace and mood of your edit
